scope: Produce standalone full artwork package and measured metadata; do not edit shared repository, push, alter gameplay or pretend package is integrated.
status: Production contract. Counts derive from approved22 contacts plus17 explicitly named support clips, not from a generic26x6 template.

format.body_png: RGBA, truly transparent, no baked gray/white/checkerboard, text, guide lines, dummy opponent, main sword or VFX.
format.rule: Cell size is a packaging preference, never an engine assertion. Use actual source dimensions/rect; never shrink high-resolution bodies or stretch frames merely to fit a box. Retain full body, hair, fan, scabbard and fingers.
format.source_pixel_policy: Preserve original generation and alpha. Safe rectangular crop/metadata only; regenerate broken hands, merged poses or baked sword rather than erasing parts to hide defects.
format.body_height_definition: Same upright anatomical scale ruler across crouch, air and down. Never use the current pose bounding-box height.
format.world_height_note: Current runtime uses155 for Hideyoshi and other non-Oichi heroes. Approved compact build is proportion; reducing world height requires integration decision.

naming.optional_sheet: sheets/body/<clip>.png (3columns x2rows, numbered only on review copy)

frame_contract.coordinate_system: rect is source PNG coordinates; foot, hand, second_hand, hand_occluders and clip_polygon are crop-local pixels. Do not add loader padding. Loader adds2px on all sides itself.
frame_contract.angle: Main sword source tip up=0 degrees; clockwise positive; tip right=90; baseline actor faces right. 09 and21 are deliberate leftward return cuts relative to the baseline.
frame_contract.foot_anchor: Grounded: planted sole or stable support point. Air/lying: anatomical virtual root preserving physical scale and world motion, not a changing tight-bbox bottom. Keep anchor inside isolated texture; export padded cell if necessary.
frame_contract.hand_anchor: Primary/anatomical right-hand grip at the sword asset grip. Record actual left hand too for two-handed validation. second_hand does not currently solve sword IK.
frame_contract.occlusion: Main weapon may draw behind or in front of body; fingers/palm from body are then redrawn with hand_occluders. Rectangles must be measured per frame, just enough to cover fingers, not repainting large torso patches.
frame_contract.weapon_grounded: Leave false for this approved katana kit: 07/11/14 do not scrape or smash the ground; existing grounded adjustment is spear-only.
frame_contract.never_fabricate: Do not fill measured hand/foot/occluder fields before viewing actual generated pixels. A template with unknown values is not a valid completed registration.

weapon_grip_extension.status: Proposed helper/Codex extension, not consumed by current remote renderer.
weapon_grip_extension.offset_definition: weapon_grip_offset_normalized is a 2D offset in canonical weapon-source axes, normalized by that weapon spec.length. Effective grip = spec.grip + offset * spec.length. Positive y points from blade tip toward pommel in canonical tip-up source.
weapon_grip_extension.override_definition: weapon_grip_override_by_id, if needed, maps actual weapon_id to absolute [x,y] coordinates in that weapon source image; a single pixel override cannot be shared across different source textures.
weapon_grip_extension.pilot_candidate: Two-handed pilot suggested [0,-0.06] but this is a candidate for visually verified frames, NOT a blanket rule for all swords or all frames.
weapon_grip_extension.order: Resolve weapon-specific base grip/override, apply explicit normalized offset, then compose scale/angle and body primary hand. Preserve body hand anchor and original world_length.
weapon_grip_extension.secondary_hand: Validate right hand nearer guard and left hand nearer pommel along the actual arm chains. Record both contact points and per-frame hand_occluders; spacing labels alone do not establish anatomy.
weapon_grip_extension.qa: Compare all supported sword hilts, at minimum uchigatana, kanesada_mino85 and okanehira115; both hands must land inside the handle without guard/pommel overlap or unintended blade grip.

layers.body: Human, costume, generic empty scabbard and fixed fan may be authored here. No fixed primary sword blade, guard or handle; otherwise switching swords doubles or leaves the old weapon.
layers.fixed_fan: Not inventory equipment. Exactly one per frame: stowed for ordinary/double-hand sword actions; left hand in special1 andspecial2; stowed again in special3. Guard may use fan if clearly registered.
layers.fan_transition: Make stow/draw fan visibly plausible in transitions, no instant duplicate on sash and hand. Transition itself does not add attack damage.
layers.throw_target: The gray opponent on approved19 is a reference only. Actual target must be independently rendered; body layer contains only Hideyoshi. A separate neutral reference target layer is allowed for previews.
layers.sheathed_weapon: Approved19 andcharge/charged transition require equipped hilt visible while blade is concealed. Current renderer only has weapon_visible, no complete scabbard masking/sheathed-hilt mode. Deliver separate proposed mask/anchor data or clearly labeled handoff need; do not bake a particular hilt into the body.
layers.effects: No slashes/wind/glow in body atlas. Optional transparent effect references separately; no phantom sword extending hitbox.

swap_contract.target_family: sword (approved choice, NOT existing code state)
checks: Same body pixels for each equipped sword.
Preserve each item world_length and grip; no forced same blade length.
Both hands grip handle rather than blade; account for varying hilt proportions.
Test right and left facing and09/21return cuts.
No blade/hilt duplicate left in body or scabbard.
swap_contract.technical_limit: Weapon artwork does not automatically determine collision: current melee uses action reach+weapon reach_bonus. Weapon-image geometry and new katana hit zones must be aligned later.

clips.name: 站立
clips.design: 呼吸與重心微調，原地完整6姿勢；刀可安全低持，扇收妥

clips.name: 走路
clips.design: 左脚開→窄→交錯→右脚開→窄→交錯，放開立刻idle

clips.name: 跑步
clips.design: 6個真實跑姿，腳步展開、交替支撐、騰空，不能只平移walk

clips.name: 跳躍
clips.design: 壓腿起跳→上升→收腿頂點→伸腿下降→預備落地→吸收落地
clips.timing_reference: 现行按vz選6格，不是固定fps；不能把腿收起後按短bbox放大

clips.name: 原地蓄力保持
clips.design: 12詐退居合之前的收刀準備、半納刀、集中保持；不提前斬出
clips.timing_reference: 35tick滿蓄；現行只推進至第3格保持，4–6為新滿蓄保持候選，需Codex路由

clips.name: 上向蓄力保持
clips.design: 與13旋身昇刃相接，低架斜刀預備，充能保持不揮出

clips.name: 下向蓄力保持
clips.design: 與14低身落葉斬相接，低身蓄勢，刀尖仍離地

clips.name: 擒拿持有
clips.design: 19前置控腕／抓持姿勢，刀入鞘，双手控制；敵人獨立層
clips.timing_reference: 最長180tick；30tick單次50%掙脫；现行僅前3格保持，細節動畫需新路由

clips.name: 防禦及擋中
clips.design: 01進入、02架起、03維持、04受壓過渡、05擋中、06回復；若扇擋需扇在左手且腰部不重複
clips.timing_reference: 现行第3格保持，guard_hit顯示第5格

clips.name: 受擊
clips.design: 肩髖受震→彎腰失衡→最大受擊→回穩；不能只整圖震動

clips.name: 被抓掙扎
clips.design: 6個手脚／肩髖掙扎姿勢，與被抓相對位置一致，刀/扇仍合理保管
clips.timing_reference: 新獨立clip，現有renderer把grabbed直接轉hurt，需Codex改路由

clips.name: 被拉近
clips.design: 前臂／肩膀被牽拉、後脚踉蹌失衡，身體方向與移動相配
clips.timing_reference: 新獨立clip，現有renderer把pulled轉hurt，需Codex改路由

clips.name: 擊飛／被投飛
clips.design: 上升、翻身失衡、頂點、下降、護身、落地前；原身高尺保持

clips.name: 倒地及死亡末態
clips.design: 倒下銜接→落地→躺平；末格穩定，雙腳和頭不裁掉
clips.timing_reference: 现行24tick落到末格；死亡hold末格，存活倒地之後才recovering

clips.name: 起身
clips.design: 躺平→掌撐→侧身→单膝→半站→站穩
clips.timing_reference: 36tick；現有完成起身有2傷害震開，屬程式效果不是新攻擊圖

clips.name: 暈眩
clips.design: 頭／肩搖晃、腳不穩但不倒地，6姿勢可循環

clips.name: 勝利
clips.design: 收刀／開扇發令式慶祝→回穩→定案終態，動作完整
clips.timing_reference: 120tick播放6格，末格保持；不回idle或倒地
